WITH target AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_id, mission_key
  FROM governance.missions
  WHERE ({{$json.mission_id ? ''' + $json.mission_id + ''' : 'NULL'}} IS NOT NULL AND id = {{$json.mission_id ? ''' + $json.mission_id + ''' : 'NULL'}}::uuid)
     OR ({{$json.mission_key ? ''' + $json.mission_key.replace(/'/g, '\'\'') + ''' : 'NULL'}} IS NOT NULL AND mission_key = {{$json.mission_key ? ''' + $json.mission_key.replace(/'/g, '\'\'') + ''' : 'NULL'}})
  LIMIT 1
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    t.mission_id,
    t.mission_key,
    COUNT(r.id) AS report_count,
    string_agg(
      format('- repo_id=%s head_sha=%s at=%s hash=%s', r.repo_id, r.head_sha, to_char(r.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SSOF'), r.report_hash),
      E'\n'
      ORDER BY r.created_at
    ) AS report_lines
  FROM target t
  LEFT JOIN governance.mission_tasks mt ON mt.mission_id = t.mission_id
  LEFT JOIN governance.reports r ON r.mission_task_id = mt.id
  GROUP BY t.mission_id, t.mission_key
)
SELECT
  mission_id,
  mission_key,
  CASE WHEN report_count = 0 THEN 'NO_GO' ELSE 'CONDITIONAL_GO' END AS outcome,
  format('# Decision %s\n\nOutcome: %s\n\nMission: %s\n\nReports:\n%s', mission_key, CASE WHEN report_count = 0 THEN 'NO_GO' ELSE 'CONDITIONAL_GO' END, mission_key, coalesce(report_lines, '- no reports')) AS decision_md
FROM agg;

UPDATE governance.missions
SET status = 'closed', closed_at = now()
WHERE id = {{$node['Compute Decision Hash'].json['mission_id'] ? ''' + $node['Compute Decision Hash'].json['mission_id'] + ''' : 'NULL'}}::uuid
RETURNING id;
